original_description: Poolday is an AI video editing platform. With this plugin you brief the Poolday agent from the chat and it does the production work in your Poolday workspace: scripting, footage, voiceover, music, captions, brand kits and rendering. A task runs for minutes in the background. The plugin shows it in a live panel with its status, any question the agent needs answered, and the finished video or image outputs with links to open them in Poolday. You can follow up on a task with a change ("make it 15 seconds", "use the second voice"), answer the agent's questions from the chat, find earlier tasks, and drop files from your computer into the panel so a task can use them. Media already in your Poolday library can be referenced in a brief, and links to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or web pages are fetched by Poolday. Connecting asks you to sign in to Poolday and pick one workspace; everything the plugin does happens in that workspace, as you, within your workspace's permissions and credits.
summary_ja: Pooldayのワークスペースで動画や画像の制作を依頼し、進捗や修正を管理する。
limitations: Pooldayへのサインインとワークスペースの選択が必要。権限とクレジットの範囲内で動作。
実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
